slices.title: LoopGuard helper and gateway inline loop
slices.summary: Adds a pure LoopGuard in mp-contracts that observes each tool round and returns Continue, Remind (at 3 and 5 repeats) or Stop (at 8 repeats, or on a cycle or no-progress pattern), and wires it into the gateway inline tool loop behind LOOP_GUARD_MODE with shadow as the default. The guard never executes or retries a tool; the content-free stop is persisted in run audit detail only.
slices.flag: LOOP_GUARD_MODE (model-gateway; off/shadow/enforce; unknown = shadow, observational label per K3-26)
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p mp-contracts loop_guard
cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -p model-gateway duplicate_signature

slices.title: LoopGuard in the Do loop, typed stop
slices.summary: Runs a canonical-signature LoopGuard in the execution-core Do loop and ends a looping run with a typed loop_detected stop: a failed run with a fixed reply and no further dispatch of a write. A child loop stop is a typed child result and does not stop the parent. The stop code is a new RunAgentResponse field at binding tag 10; the name failure_code is already used at tag 6 (see notes, conflict 1).
slices.flag: LOOP_GUARD_MODE (execution-core, own environment variable; off/shadow/enforce; unknown = shadow)

slices.title: hook_context into Do runs, strictest-wins evaluator, fail-closed
slices.summary: Passes the org hook context into Do runs in place of the empty string, replaces first-match with a strictest-wins evaluator (deny over ask over allow) that fails closed on malformed context, and withholds the result of a denied post-tool call while keeping the step successful. Adds an OrgPolicyContext message as RunAgentRequest.org_policy at binding tag 24, and a priority field at tag 8 on the gateway Hook message.

slices.title: Gateway handles for remaining read tools
slices.summary: Parks oversized output of fetch_url, knowledge_search and web_search behind gateway handles that are readable by range (4,000 characters per read), and replays the stored screening verdict and trust label on every read. Parking is refused for external content whose screening was skipped, and never happens under ZDR.

test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -p model-gateway tool_result_handles

slices.title: Execution-core run-scoped handles and result_query
slices.summary: Adds a per-run in-memory handle store in execution-core that parks oversized read-class tool output and serves it back in slices through result_query; the store is capped at 1 MiB per handle and 4 MiB per run, released at finalize, and under ZDR output falls back to inline. The query logic moves into mp-contracts so the gateway and execution-core share it, and a read-class capability row lets dispatch pass the signed gate.
slices.flag: EXECUTION_RESULT_HANDLES (execution-core; vocab C; on/off; default off)

slices.title: AgentMode vocabulary and resolution seam
slices.summary: Adds the four agent modes (lockdown, read_only, ask_first, auto) with a strictest-wins resolve over the platform floor, the org cap and the user's choice, a pinned golden, and an optional agent_mode field on invoke behind AGENT_MODES. With no choice the request is byte-identical; an unknown mode is refused with agent_mode_unknown; the chat client sends the mode, and the action contract is registered first.

slices.title: Enforcement: policy client, mode and rung caps, lockdown, extension allow-lists
slices.summary: Makes the org policy bind: the gateway reads it through a cached client (30 s TTL; stale-if-error bounds of 900 s after a restrictive answer and 120 s after a permissive one, then typed 503 org_policy_unavailable for Do runs); the mode resolves against the cap with lockdown refused as mode_lockdown; rung grants clamp to the rung cap; and capability-core hides and denies MCP servers and tools outside the org allow-list (org_extension_not_allowed). Behind ORG_AGENT_POLICY_MODE (off/shadow/enforce) and ORG_EXTENSION_ALLOWLIST.
